Subject: Observed anomaly — request for telemetry + SOC2/SIG evidence

Hi Sofia,

Quick note from our security team — this morning we saw a spike in anomalous request rates from a small set of tenants between 02:12–02:45 UTC on 2027-05-01. Nothing persisted after 03:00 UTC but we would like to collect a short telemetry snapshot to correlate with our logs and ask for your SOC 2 evidence and SIG/CAIQ mapping for any controls related to incident detection, alerting, and telemetry retention.

Specifically we need:
- A telemetry package (prefix + sampled request logs, trace IDs, and KV-cache events) covering 2027-05-01 02:00–04:00 UTC.
- A short copy of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) executive summary showing escalation contacts and retention policy (SOC 2 related).
- SIG / CAIQ mapping matrix relevant to Logging/Monitoring and Incident Management controls.

Can you confirm scope and whether you can supply a sanitized telemetry bundle and the SOC 2/SIG artifacts within 24 hours? Our audit team has a tight window today and we may need a presigned link for secure download.

Thanks —
Maya Patel
Security Operations Lead
FinWorks
maya@finworks.com
+1 415-555-0192
